        Str('h'); bool talked = Next(mTalk); W('!'); W(talked ? '1' : '0'); UnStr('h');

            if (T()) return;

            Movie();

            if (T()) return;
            if (m.attacked && m.attspeech) {

            } else if (!m.intro) {

                if (T()) return;

                ReleaseIfValid();
                if (StartMe()) return;
                if (T()) return;

            } else {
                if (m.trophy == 1) ++cBlather; else ++cBlather2;         // the fitted read: both outcomes the same terminate check
                if (T()) return;
                ReleaseIfValid();
                if (StartMe()) return;
                if (T()) return;
                if (Say('b')) return;
            }
            Pop(); Pop();
        } else if (m.attacked) {
            if (T()) return;
            if (!m.attspeech) {
                if (T()) return;
                W('i');
                ReleaseIfValid();
                if (StartMe()) return;
                if (T()) return;
                Movie();
                if (Say('a')) return;

                Pop(); Pop();

        }
        if (Timer('a') <= 0) {
            if (T()) return;
            W('d'); Ws("=a"); mDeedTimer = D_DEED; ++cDeed;

    }
}
